data.body: Fix applied: Added 'origin/main' fallback is-ancestor check to _offer_worktree_cleanup (claude-safe lines 113-131) and added 'origin/$target_branch' fallback to is_branch_merged (worktree-cleanup.sh lines 217-238). Both checks now consult the remote tracking branch when local main is stale. RED test added: tests/scripts/test-claude-safe-stale-local-main.sh (3 tests, all GREEN). Existing PR merge detection and post-merge amend tests still pass.
